corrected_code:
class CollaborativeDocumentConsumer(AsyncWebsocketConsumer):
    async def connect(self):
        user = self.scope.get('user')
        if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
            await self.close()
            return
        self.doc_id = self.scope['url_route']['kwargs']['doc_id']
        can_access = await database_sync_to_async(
            Document.objects.filter(id=self.doc_id, collaborators=user).exists
        )()
        if not can_access:
            await self.close()
            return
        await self.channel_layer.group_add(f"doc_{self.doc_id}", self.channel_name)
        await self.accept()
        await self.send(text_data=json.dumps({'status': 'connected', 'doc_id': self.doc_id}))
